rows.quote: The dataset used in this study, designated as finngen_R10_C3_PANCREAS_ADENO_DUCTAL_EXALLC.gz, includes 731 pancreatic cancer patients and 314,193 healthy controls (n = 731 cases; n = 314,193 controls).
rows.coder_note: The file name finngen_R10_... states release R10 for the analysis dataset.
Passages name the project and cite one paper whose DOI belongs to several candidate rows; no sample size or subcohort is given to choose among them.
